name: AFFALTER A45 S

specs.notes: Mercedes-AMG's A 45 S 4MATIC+: the M139 2.0 turbo four, the most powerful series four-cylinder at 421 PS and 500 N m, an eight-speed dual clutch, 4MATIC+ with a drift mode, ~1,635 kg, 0-100 km/h in 3.9 s, 270 km/h. Its torque curve, ratios and aero are estimates.

garage.blurb: A hot hatch with a hand-built 421 horsepower four: tiny, fierce and four-wheel drive, with a party trick that sends it all to the back.
